item.title: EU 'Digital Fairness Act' Could Have A Huge Impact On Loot Boxes And Virtual Currency

description.p: A step in the right direction?After being leaked earlier this week, the European Commission has today presented its proposal for the 'Digital Fairness Act' — a rule update that aims to offer "better protection for consumers and fairer competition for businesses" in the games industry.To be clear, the proposal has not been adopted by the EU Commission just yet, but if it does go through, it could have a huge impact on several hot-topic game mechanics like loot boxes, virtual currencies, pay-to-win options and more. What's more, the act would apply to all EU member states without the need for individual approval.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time "Off To A Great Start", Says Nintendo

description.p: No specific numbers yet, though.Nintendo has released the Q&A translation from its latest financial briefing, with president Shuntaro Furukawa stating that Zelda: Ocarina of Time is "off to a great start".The comment comes off the back of a question related to the decrease in hardware sales for the Switch 2, which saw a dip of 37% year-on-year. Furukawa-san explained that Japan saw a significant spike in sales prior to the price revision in May before settling down after. Overseas, meanwhile, Nintendo allowed customers ample time to purchase the Switch 2 before the price went up while also offering multiple bundles.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "Why Is It Not Fun?" - Doug Bowser Gives A Peek Into Nintendo's Strategy Sessions

description.p: The eyes have it.It's no secret that when it comes to game development, Nintendo is all about fun.
